summary: The long warm-brick massing, layered hipped roof, cream cornices, and restrained miniature treatment are recognizable, but two defining West Lake elevations are substantially under-described.

orientation.summary: The principal entrance is correctly placed on the -u/SE end: located SV2 looks WNW toward that face and shows the raised double-door entrance on the right side, matching the labeled -u render and actual -u door inventory. The separate -v/SW door is not a duplicated principal portal and reasonably represents veranda access seen from West Lake Road.

issues.problem: The -v/West Lake Road face lacks the reference’s continuous pale-post veranda, one of the building’s strongest identifying features; the render instead reads as an exposed storefront-like wall.
issues.fix: Add a shallow full-length veranda roof with evenly spaced pale posts and keep the openings visually subordinate behind it.

issues.problem: The raised central roof tier has blank brick sides, while SV4 shows a conspicuous rhythm of clerestory windows beneath the upper cornice.
issues.fix: Add simplified, clearly readable clerestory windows along the raised roof tier, prioritizing rhythm over exact count.
